text:
Type: TV media console
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storage; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: wood in a dark walnut finish, framed glass door panels, round knobs
Colors: dark espresso brown, smoky grey glass
Shape: rectangular, two open shelves with cord holes above, two grid-paned glass doors below, overhanging top, short square tapered legs, medium and solid
Feel: warm, grounded, orderly
Goes with: cream walls, warm wood floors, leather sofas; traditional or classic living rooms

product.name: Ravenna Home Classic Media Center with Glass-Front Cabinets, 44"W, Walnut Wood
product.description: 44" W X 22" D X 27" H Solid wood with glass doors Large top shelf allows for storage while 2 lower cabinets with glass-front doors provide stylish storage solutions. 2 glass-front cabinets, multiple shelves Assemble in 30 minutes-1 hour Wipe clean with soft, dry cloth.
